performance_case.causal_mechanism: A fixed inactive Unix launcher, isolated source identity and exact release verifier reduce the lead time from an accepted carry package to lawful forward evidence without introducing a second clock or writer.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This dispatch can prove only a five-file static inactive installation design. Package execution, Linux identity and systemd enforcement, deployment, registration, evidence, PnL and drawdown remain Manager-side or forward MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero because the unit remains disabled and unbound; any future path-risk improvement requires a separately preregistered matched-capital forward experiment.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Freezing Unix isolation before canonical integration prevents a network-capable source from receiving broad paths or lifecycle authority and avoids spending server capacity on an installation that cannot be safely verified or rolled back.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted PnL effect is zero; the infrastructure value is faster, fail-closed installation of a future carry evidence source so the causal DRA admission mechanism can be accepted or rejected sooner.
